title: A fictional offline index keeps one reviewed trail
thesis: A fictional handbook's reviewed-trail rule is a candidate design pattern for an offline index; it is not measured evidence about real field teams.

units.text: keep one reviewed trail for every index entry.
The handbook asks a fictional note-taker to keep one reviewed trail for every index entry.
A fictional editor should let the reviewed trail, not the loudest screenshot, decide what the index admits.
The handbook rule is a fictional design pattern, not a measured outcome.

withheld.text: A screenshot is enough to prove the full context of a fictional note.
withheld.reason: The fictional handbook says the opposite; this statement has no admitted support.

unknowns: No real field team, site or archive was observed; every name and record is fictional.
